performance_case.causal_mechanism: Separating Manager-owned semantic validation from Local native exact-byte verification removes local Python availability as a task-start bottleneck without duplicating or weakening the schema rules.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This dispatch can prove only a zero-write runtime-neutral Local preflight and static carry timeout audit; it cannot prove a local schema engine, installed systemd behavior, evidence, PnL, drawdown or strategy readiness.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero because this is a read-only orchestration audit; any future path-risk effect requires separately preregistered forward evidence.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Using the existing Manager validator and native Local hashing avoids maintaining a second validator while restoring bounded Local throughput in an isolated environment without Python execution.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Immediate fee-adjusted PnL effect is zero; the capability value is reducing avoidable Local task startup failures so evidence-ready mechanisms can be accepted or rejected with less orchestration delay.
